rationale: Kefir-fermented soy milk was tested in mice for exercise endurance and physiological responses. No plain dairy kefir or human fatigue scale.

IBD abdominal pain review includes fermented or probiotic interventions and mentions fatigue as background. No isolated plain-kefir patient fatigue result.
Kefir with exercise in cancer survivors had a favorable reported fatigue result. Flavor and exact journal contrast remain unverified. The 19 and 24 participant reports are likely one study family.

Food spoilage and antibacterial tests use herbs on meat. No participants or cognitive task.

rationale: An odor study presents marjoram as a stimulus and measures pleasantness, recognition and familiarity. It does not assess clinical attention change.
